etymology_chain.definition: this (masculine singular demonstrative base with analogical -n)

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic masculine demonstrative base ذَا (ḏā). While earlier 20th-century philologists (Aquilina 1973: 16) compared final -n to ancient Semitic forms (Biblical Aramaic dēn, Phoenician zn) to refute Barbera's Sicilian borrowing theory, modern comparative Maltese and Arabic linguistics (Borg, Vanhove) refutes any ancient substrate origin. Instead, final -n is analyzed as an internal dialectal Arabic innovation: the plural nasal from dawn (cp. Maghrebi hadun, hadhūna) spread analogically to the singulars (da > dan, di > din), reinforced by the proximal locative hawn ('here'). The bare stem survives in proclitic da, while the Classical jew MSA compound with deictic hā- (هٰذَا hāḏā) survives in oratorical hedan via Maltese imāla (hā- > he-).

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from dialectal Maghrebi Arabic plural demonstratives (cp. etymology_chain.definition: compound of deictic particle hā- + base ḏā

entries.etymology_notes: Directly derives from Classical jew MSA هٰذَا (hāḏā), compounding the deictic alerting particle هَا (hā-) + demonstrative base ذَا (ḏā), with analogical -n and regular Maltese imāla (hā- > he-). Aquilina (1973: 16) notes this form survived 'confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect' because sacred oratory preserved the elevated Classical jew MSA compound with the deictic particle.

usage_examples.mt: Hedan huwa l-misteru kbir tal-fidi li qegħdin niċċelebraw illum.
usage_examples.en: This is the great mystery of faith that we are celebrating today.

usage_examples.mt: Hedan il-jum imqaddes ifakkarna fl-imħabba infinita ta' Alla.
usage_examples.en: This holy day reminds us of God's infinite love.

entries.audit_notes: Confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect; variant of primary lemma 'dan'.

usage_notes.en: Oratorical, archaic, or ecclesiastical proximal masculine demonstrative with inherited deictic prefix he- (from Arabic hā-). Preserved in formal sermons and literature.
usage_notes.mt: Għamla oratorja, arkajka u ekkleżjastika ta' dan, bil-prefiss deittiku he-. Ippreservata fil-priedki u fil-letteratura għolja.

usage_notes.en: Selective interrogative determiner and pronoun. Unlike open interrogative x' or xiex ('what'), liema asks for a specific selection among an existing or known set ('which of these'). Followed by a noun with or without the article (liema triq, liema wieħed).
usage_notes.mt: Determinant u pronom interrogattiv selettiv. Għall-kuntrarju ta' x' jew xiex li jistaqsi b'mod ġenerali, liema jistaqsi għal għażla speċifika minn fost ġabra magħrufa ('liema minn dawn'). Jiġi segwit minn nom bl-artiklu jew mingħajru (liema triq, liema wieħed).

usage_notes.en: Preposed indefinite determiner derived from Arabic shay' ('thing'). Directly precedes an indefinite singular noun without article (xi ktieb 'some book'). Before numerals and measures, it conveys approximation (xi għaxar minuti 'about ten minutes'). Fuses or combines with nouns to form standard indefinite pronouns: xi ħadd ('someone'), xi ħaġa ('something'), xi mkien ('somewhere').
usage_notes.mt: Determinant indefinit imqiegħed qabel nom singulari indeterminat mingħajr artiklu (xi ktieb). Qabel numri u miżuri juri stima approssimattiva (xi għaxar minuti). Jingħaqad ma' nomi biex joħloq pronomi indefiniti: xi ħadd, xi ħaġa, xi mkien.

definitions.text_mt: Pronom indefinit negattiv li jindika nuqqas assolut ta' oġġetti, valur, fatti jew materja f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

usage_notes.en: Negative polarity pronoun derived from Arabic shay'an. When used with a verb, it requires the standard Maltese discontinuous negation ma...x (e.g. ma rajt xejn 'I saw nothing'). When used standalone, it expresses an absolute negative answer ('Nothing'). Also functions adverbially before adjectives (xejn faċli 'not at all easy') and in polite formulas (ta' xejn 'you are welcome').
usage_notes.mt: Pronom b'polarità negattiva derivat mill-Għarbi shay'an. Ma' verb jeħtieġ in-negazzjoni standard ma...x (eż. ma rajt xejn). Weħdu jesprimi tweġiba negattiva diretta ('Xejn'). Jintuża wkoll b'mod avverbjali quddiem aġġettivi (xejn faċli) u fi frażijiet ta' kortesija (ta' xejn).

usage_examples.mt: Jekk ma taqbilx ma' din il-proposta, għidilna b'xi soluzzjoni oħra.
usage_examples.en: If you do not agree with this proposal, tell us about another solution.

usage_notes.en: Masculine singular alterative determiner and adjective. Placed postpositively after the noun (raġel ieħor 'another man', il-ktieb l-ieħor 'the other book'). Takes definite article l- when modifying an articulated noun. Feminine form: oħra; plural: oħrajn (human) or oħra (inanimate).
usage_notes.mt: Determinant u aġġettiv alterattiv maskil singular. Jitqiegħed wara n-nom (raġel ieħor, il-ktieb l-ieħor). Jieħu l-artiklu meta jimmodifika nom determinat. Femminil: oħra; plural: oħrajn jew oħra.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic ʾanā, evolving in sedentary Western Arabic via diphthongization and final nasalization (*ʾānā > *yān > jien).

definitions.text_mt: Pronom personali tal-ewwel persuna singular, użat biex jindika l-kelliem innifsu bħala suġġett tal-espressjoni.
Jintuża bħala kopula tal-ewwel persuna singular fi sentenzi nominali fil-preżent.

usage_notes.en: First-person singular pronoun of common gender (used by any speaker). The augmented variant jiena is also standard and commonly used for rhythmic balance or emphasis at phrase boundaries.
usage_notes.mt: Pronom personali tal-ewwel persuna singular b'ġeneru komuni (użat minn kwalunkwe kelliem). L-għamla miżjuda jiena hija standard ukoll u tintuża komunement għal bilanċ ritmiku jew għal enfasi fl-aħħar ta' frażi.

usage_examples.mt: Jien lest li ngħinek f'kull ħaġa li teħtieġ.
usage_examples.en: I am ready to help you with anything you need.

usage_examples.mt: Jien student fl-Università ta' Malta.
usage_examples.en: I am a student at the University of Malta.

entries.audit_notes: Canonical first-person singular pronoun authored to complete the pronominal inventory.

definitions.text_mt: Pronom personali tat-tielet persuna singular femminil li jirreferi għal mara jew għal oġġett grammatikalment femminil bħala suġġett tal-klawżola.
Jintuża bħala kopula ta' rabta femminili bejn is-suġġett u l-predikat fi sentenzi nominali fil-preżent.

usage_notes.en: Canonical third-person singular feminine pronoun. Functions as a subject pronoun and as a feminine present-tense copula in equational clauses.
usage_notes.mt: Pronom personali indipendenti tat-tielet persuna singular femminil. Jintuża bħala suġġett kif ukoll bħala kopula femminili fil-preżent f'sentenzi nominali.

usage_examples.mt: Hija ddeċidiet li tkompli l-istudji tagħha barra minn Malta.
usage_examples.en: She decided to continue her studies abroad.

usage_examples.mt: Din hija l-aqwa deċiżjoni li stajna nieħdu f'din is-sitwazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: This is the best decision we could have made in this situation.

definitions.text_mt: Pronom personali tat-tieni persuna plural (għall-maskil u l-femminil), użat bħala suġġett biex jindika żewġ persuni jew aktar li magħhom qed jitkellem il-kelliem.
Jintuża bħala kopula fit-tieni persuna plural fi sentenzi nominali fil-preżent.

usage_notes.en: Second-person plural pronoun, used when addressing two or more people regardless of gender. Functions as subject pronoun and present-tense plural copula.
usage_notes.mt: Pronom personali tat-tieni persuna plural, użat biex jindirizza żewġ persuni jew aktar bla distinzjoni ta' ġeneru. Jintuża bħala suġġett u bħala kopula plurali fil-preżent.

usage_examples.mt: Intom mistiedna lkoll għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' għada filgħaxija.
usage_examples.en: You are all invited to tomorrow evening's celebration.

usage_examples.mt: Intom tafu tajjeb kemm ħdimna biex nilħqu dan il-għan.
usage_examples.en: You know well how hard we worked to achieve this goal.

entries.audit_notes: Authored second-person plural pronoun to complete the pronominal paradigm.
